preconditions.description: All characters in the input string s are lowercase letters.
The integer k is at least 1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(len(T) for T in [s[i:j] for i in range(len(s)) for j in range(i+1, len(s)+1)] if all(s.count(c) >= k for c in set(T))) if any(all(s.count(c) >= k for c in set(T)) for T in [s[i:j] for i in range(len(s)) for j in range(i+1, len(s)+1)]) else 0
postconditions.description: The function returns the length of the longest substring T of s where every character in T appears at least k times in s. If no such substring exists, it returns 0.
